meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 多了 iMessage 入口：机器人能通过 iMessage 和你对话，消息走本机 Mac 的 iMessage（需授权完全磁盘访问）或远程 Photon。安装过程会让你选模式、填信息并自动重启。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等关键词，或要求把 iMessage 接进 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.note: 会引导你选择本地或远程模式。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程接入 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥。
需在 Mac 上授予 Node 完全磁盘访问权限。

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: the bot can send/receive iMessages via the local Mac's account (Full Disk Access required) or a remote Photon server. Setup asks you to pick a mode, enters credentials, configures, and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc., or when you ask to add iMessage to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: It will guide you to choose local or remote mode.
You'll need to provide a Photon server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Set up local iMessage on this Mac.
say_en.note: Full Disk Access for Node is required.
